sense.text:
“Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.” The new moon is the beginning of the month, and it is a solemn feast day. In the new moon Israel blew up the trumpet, in the time appointed every month.

The trumpet was blown to gather Israel together. It was not only blown on the new moon but on the sabbath and on all the solemn feast days, the Passover and the rest; it was done right through. It was also blown when Israel went to war, it was blown for an alarm, and it was blown when Israel wanted God to come and fight for them. That is why in the seventh month Israel keeps the memorial of blowing of trumpets: a memorial of the trumpets blown every month and on every feast day.

“For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.” Blowing up the trumpets in the new moon and coming together every new moon is a statute, and it is a law. Every new moon is a solemn assembly. That is why Israel is gathered tonight.

precepts.why:
“Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings.” The days of our gladness are our feast days, the days when we come together and have fun. Solemn days are holy days. And the beginnings of the months is the beginning of every month: the new moon.

The law was that Israel blew the trumpet over the offerings, and when they made peace offerings they blew up the trumpets, when they came up to the temple. “That they may be to you for a memorial before your God.”

So in the beginning of the months God commanded Israel to come together. It is a solemn feast day, the same day Psalms 81 says to blow up the trumpet in the new moon.

sense.text:
Our forefathers practised sexual discipline. “For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother’s womb”: some are born with the manhood not working; something is wrong with it down there. “And there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men”: like Daniel, whom they cut when he went into captivity.

“And there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake.” These made up their minds, for the kingdom of heaven’s sake, to abstain from marriage and abstain from sex. Paul did that: he could have got married, but he disciplined himself not to have sex and not to marry, because he had a lot of work to do and no time to start a family and deal with a wife.

Christ did it too. Christ had sexual urges, for he was tempted on all points, on every level we are, and he did not give in to them. John the Baptist practised sexual discipline the same way. They did not marry and did not have sex while they were on this earth. That is sexual discipline, and if we want the kingdom of heaven we also have to learn to practise it.

Sex was designed for procreation: God put Adam in the flesh and told him to be fruitful and multiply. It is done between a married man and a married woman, it is pleasurable, and it builds a bond, so that the two become one flesh. What our people have done, today and in the past, is take away the procreation and the becoming one and use it only for pleasure: going to prostitutes, watching porn and jerking off to get that feeling.

precepts.why:
The opposite of a eunuch is a widow. When people read about widows they think it is only a woman whose husband died, but there was more to it. A widow took a vow: to serve God, to fast and pray, and to help the brothers and sisters in the body, and not to deal with a man again, for the kingdom’s sake. Judith was a widow; she was young, her husband died, and she made a vow to God not to marry again, fasting and praying most of the week. There are two kinds: a sister whose husband died, and a woman who makes a vow to serve and worship God, whether she has no husband or her husband died.

“But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry.” Refuse the young women, the thirty and forty year olds, who come saying they want to dedicate their lives to God and want no man. When they begin to get horny, they will go and get married. Back then some sisters took the vow of widowhood without sexual discipline and broke it.

It is not wrong to get married, but read on: “Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.” They bring damnation on themselves because they made a vow to control their sexual desires, be abstinent and serve God, and went against it. Their first faith was to be practising abstinence and serving God.

So the righteous of our forefathers and foremothers had sexual discipline: men who made themselves eunuchs, and women who made the vow of the widow.

sense.text: “Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary.” His sabbaths are not only the seventh day, but the new moon, the Passover and all the high holy days. He says to reverence his sanctuary because his sabbaths are a holy convocation, a holy gathering: on the sabbath it was commanded for all of Israel to go up to the temple and serve the Lord.

precepts.why:
“And if any man’s seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.” If you had sex, God says you have to wash yourself, and you are unclean until the evening. “And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.” And the woman too: “they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.”

So by the law, if you had sex with your wife, you were unclean. And you could not go up to the temple being unclean. That is why the sabbaths and the sanctuary are tied together: Israel had to go up on every high holy day.

“Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.” The tabernacle was the temple.

Could you have sex and go up to the temple on the new moon, or on the sabbath? After evening on Friday night, back then, you could not have sex, because you would be unclean, and it was a commandment for all of Israel to come up to the tabernacle and worship God every high holy day. The priests who did the service had to control their sexual appetite: a new moon is coming, I have to go up and do the Lord’s work, so I cannot have sex. Our forefathers practised sexual discipline.

That law does not apply today, because the tabernacle is not here, and that burden is not put on us now.

But see what will happen when the Lord returns: “And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord.”

When Christ returns, from one new moon to another and one sabbath to another, all of us will have to go up and worship before Christ. The law of sexual discipline we had to keep back then will be the same again when Christ returns. When the third temple is built, we cannot go up in there unclean.

sense.text:
Why is sexual discipline so hard for us today? It is by design. “The days shall come, that they which dwell upon earth shall be taken in a great number”: this is speaking of the Lord’s return, the third world war.

“And the way of truth shall be hidden”: that is the time we are living in now. The teachings of Christ are hid, and the teaching that we are the Israelites is hid. “And the land shall be barren of faith.”

“But iniquity shall be increased above that which now thou seest.” Iniquity is sin, and sin is going to increase on another level than anything ever seen on this earth. That is the answer to why sexual discipline is even harder for us than it was back in the days. So when you ask yourself why you are dealing with lust all the time, why certain thoughts keep coming into your mind, it is because of the society you are living in. It is by design.

“Or that thou hast heard long ago”: like Sodom and Gomorrah. What you heard was taking place in Sodom and Gomorrah, what takes place in the last days will be worse than that.

That is why porn is so easy to get to today. Nine-year-olds are watching it; any child with a device has access, and it pops up on the little games they play. Growing up, you had to get a VCR to watch porn, and there was one TV in the house. Now any of these devices gives everyone access. It is by design: it is going to get much wickeder than it was in Sodom and Gomorrah, so the fight we have to fight is going to be even harder.

Porn is a hardcore drug, stronger than cocaine, stronger than crack, and very hard to stop; it was hard to stop from experience, not something given up just like that. The porn today is even worse than the porn back in the days, and it will turn you gay: the whole thing is to turn the brothers gay. Men getting pegged was unheard of growing up; a brother telling his wife to peg him is gay, and it is the porn that leads down that road. It leads on to weird stuff, to ordering a robot or a sex doll, and the demons jump all on you. Leave it alone.

The pastors in Philadelphia charged with soliciting explicit videos of minors, boys, show where it ends: keep playing with porn and it turns you gay and into pedophiles. Porn is one of the biggest weapons they are using to defile our people. And it defiles the sisters too: when a woman tells her husband to choke her and flip her, it is porn she has been watching, or the many men she dealt with before.

precepts.why:
“For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people.” Darkness is wickedness, sin, and it covers the earth. Gross darkness is more darkness, and the people are the twelve tribes of Israel. Darkness covers the earth, but on the children of Israel there is even more darkness.

Look around society today: who over-sexualises everything, who is promiscuous and killing babies on a higher level than anyone else? It is us, the Israelites, the blacks and Hispanics. We are the ones in gross darkness, and the nations make fun of us and make a proverb of us, saying our culture is crap. Our culture is sex, money, murder.

The BET Awards were this week, and Black Entertainment Television is one of the most destructive cultures: all they push is sex, money, murder, women shaking their ass half naked on the television, and that is pushed on us. When you are exposed to those things it messes with your psychology. We are being attacked with psychological warfare. That is why lust and evil thoughts and evil desires are so hard for our people: it is by design.

“And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt.” Their dead bodies, because we are in a dead state of mind: we do not know who we are, and we are in the midst of sin.

America is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt. Egypt, because we are enslaved here, oppressed here, in bondage here. And Sodom: when people read about Sodom they think only of gay, homosexuality. But in Sodom and Gomorrah it was not just homosexuality. It was threesomes, women being promiscuous; everything was sexualised. That is how it started.

If this place is spiritually Sodom, it is not homosexuals alone here. People are committing adultery like crazy, people go both ways, transvestites, bisexuals, women having sex with everyone, men having sex with this woman and that woman, not for marriage and procreation but just for pleasure. The 1980 documentary on 42nd Street in Times Square showed it: young black and Hispanic boys hustling, homosexuality, everything for sale. As in Sodom, where old and young wanted to have the angels, that is the spirit that is here.

The homo who beat up the security guard and then was humping him: that is Sodom and Gomorrah. The homos there wanted to rape the angels. These homos are violent and dangerous.

“I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.”

These are the things Sodom and Gomorrah were doing: adultery, walking in lies, strengthening the hands of evildoers. God says his people back in the time of Jeremiah were like Sodom and Gomorrah: adultery, homosexuality, all kinds of filthiness.

It is not just lesbianism and homosexuality. It is adultery and women being promiscuous, giving it up to everybody. You meet a woman and she has already been with four, five, eight, twenty, thirty men and none of them married her; she was just having fun, enjoying her life. That is the same spirit that was in Sodom and Gomorrah. That is adultery and fornication.

sense.text:
Porn will also destroy your marriage. “No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man.” You are the strong man of your house, the leader of that house. When you watch porn, it does not just affect you, though Satan says it is just porn. It affects your wife, it affects your kids, and it affects you, and you do not even see it. That is from experience.

Satan makes you downplay it: you are not really committing adultery, you are not sleeping with another woman, it is just something you are watching. But really you are inviting demons into your house. All of a sudden your kids act different and weird and have demons on them, because you opened that door. Your wife opens your phone and sees that thing, and asks why you watch it and whether you find her attractive, and now she deals with low self-esteem. It is not worth it. When you open that door you let Satan into your house.

And you sisters who watch porn and tell your husband to choke you: if he does a thing one time and you both like it, that is between the two of you. But for her to tell you she wants that done to her, brother, check the Carfax.

How are we deceived in unrighteousness? You go to the movies to watch a regular action movie and all of a sudden two men are kissing. Watching that, you and the kids will think it is okay. Mr. and Mrs. Smith, Shoot ’Em Up: that is being deceived in unrighteousness. The white man understands psychology and plants seeds in our minds, so the single brother battling porn watches a sex scene and the urge creeps back up, and he starts thinking about his ex.

Music videos are women shaking their ass; Instagram is women half naked. They do not ban it, because it is deceivableness of unrighteousness: it is to make it a norm, to make society think it is okay, and to keep our people in the midst of sin and battling. Esau deceives us even in our sexual desires; it is psychological warfare. For us living in this time it is harder than in the days of our forefathers, because evil has multiplied. That is why we need the mercies of Christ.

precepts.why:
“And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death. For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me.” Sin will deceive you.

Brothers want to do right. You want to stop watching certain things, so why do you go back and do it? Because sin deceives you. This whole society is built on sin, and if every day all you see is certain things, it will affect you. In the beginning, when God saw all that wickedness, he took the righteous away so the wickedness would not corrupt them; it is the same today, this society is very evil and wicked.

For our people sex, money, murder is the black culture. When we were young, with our boys, it was who could bag the most girls, who could get her number. That is the culture, and it is wrong, and it got even worse today with Instagram and DMs.

“Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.” You cannot be ignorant of the things Satan uses to get an advantage over us. He uses movies, he uses social media, he uses these devices, these phones; really everything in this society. His job is to deceive you to commit sin.

Once you understand Satan’s devices and what is not good for you, you are already ahead in the game. If you see a sex scene in a movie, do not sit there with the popcorn: you have been deceived. The sister goes home feeling tingly, picks up the phone, and the thought comes to go back to porn. You have been abstinent a while, you saw that scene and it brought back flashbacks. Watching two people have sex on the television is pornography.

And by the law we should not look on a man’s nakedness. When you watch porn you are watching a man’s rod and a man’s booty. Satan convinces us it is not gay, but God said that is gay, and it will lead you down that road.

“Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.” Remember, with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish, and Paul said sin deceived him and slew him. Evil communications are what you listen to, what you watch, who you talk to; all of it can deceive you.

You are in this truth, so why are you talking to your ex? She calls just to see how you are doing, and you should cut it short; instead you are on the phone for hours reminiscing, she says nobody ever did it like you, and that is evil communication. Next you are at her apartment, then sin is brought forth, and it brings forth death. Then the brother says he went over there to teach her some scriptures, to bring her to the truth, and she turns out to be a demon.

sense.text:
“Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.” Walking in the spirit is not moonwalking or walking on the air. It means to put on Christ, and not to make provision for the sin, not to leave any doors open where you could fall back into it.

You have to sit down, think about it and talk to yourself: I am dealing with this, so I need to set things up so I do not fall into it. No matter how many scriptures are brought out, some will feel it tonight and say, I have to stop, this is messed up, and still go watch porn and jerk off this week.

“For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh”: this body lusts against the spirit of Christ in you, and the spirit fights against this flesh. There is a war going on. I know you brothers want to do what is right and want to stop watching porn, but it is hard: you stop for a week or two weeks and it comes back, you pray to God and it is still there. This body wants pleasure.

“And these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.” You want to do right but you cannot, because the flesh wants this and wants that and wants to feel pleasure, and there is a fight going on.

“Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness.” When you allow your flesh to take control of you, one of its works is adultery; fornication, sexual sins; uncleanness, which goes into dealing with a woman on her menstrual. All of these fall under sexual sins.

This is how Satan operates. When your wife gives birth you must wait forty days, sometimes eighty days, and when she is unclean seven days, by the fifth day you are horny, and Satan comes with the porn: jerk off. Satan does not come when you are dealing with your woman; he comes when you are not getting any. That is where the fight starts. So those eighty days, those seven days, are for getting close to the Lord: fast more, occupy yourself with the Lord. That is how you train yourself to have sexual discipline. We as men cannot let vagina, that little gratification, control us. Keep messing with porn and you will fall into heavy demons and turn into perverts, wearing women’s panties.

precepts.why:
“But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.” This explains what it means to walk in the Spirit. Put on the Lord Jesus Christ: that is the commandments and your faith. To make provision for the flesh is to not walk in the spirit.

To make provision is to make a way for you to fulfil that lust. Why talk to your ex on the phone? You are going to end up banging her. If you are struggling, delete Instagram, delete certain things, put things on your phone so you cannot go on certain sites. People say, I made a mistake, I slipped, I don’t know what happened. Did you slip and fall on him? There had to be planning: you were talking, you planned what day you would meet, and it was already in your mind. It was a decision, not a mistake.

So with porn, one of the ways is to not make provision. If it is that bad, get rid of social media. Do not say you can handle it; that is Satan telling you that, and leaving it open keeps fuelling the lust. Some say they repent but leave little doors open, and they fall back into that sin.

“Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul.” Satan tells you porn is not that bad: you are not really having sex with someone, not going out and committing adultery, it is just something you are watching. But fleshly lusts war against the soul.

Keep watching these things and it destroys your soul, and it shows in your face: you start looking like a weirdo, and it shows in your countenance. Spiritually it messes you up. It makes you think you are not worthy, it weakens your spirit; you watch porn all week and when the sabbath comes you are distant. It weighs down on your soul and becomes a burden, it brings shame, you question yourself and become weak, and who you are supposed to become takes longer to develop. A young brother who used to be among us could not stop beating his meat until the skin came off, and he ended up leaving the truth. It can become a demon.

Whether it is adultery, fornication or porn, those fleshly lusts mess you up. When the demons attack you, it is not just for the pleasure. If you are a chosen one, the demon’s job is to destroy you, pull you out of the truth and destroy your soul. When a chosen one is jerking off and watching porn, the confidence gets weak, the prayer gets weak, the mind gets foggy; you are not focused in the scriptures, you forget scriptures and keep messing up. That is what Satan is doing: making us weak. That is why they put all this porn out here, to destroy us, and we have to learn to overcome it.

Your struggle does not cancel your calling: God still called you. But the lust will stop you from mastering your calling, and you have to master it. Our seed is not common; our seed is the seed of gods. Other people can jerk off, sleep around and watch porn and feel nothing, but when we do it we feel guilt and shame, because we are the chosen ones. You are supposed to feel shame and guilt, and your conscience is supposed to be saying, what are you doing? Parents, keep an eye on these young kids: check their phones and put things on them so they cannot access certain things.

sense.text:
“And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked.” To survive in this wicked world you have to be like Lot. Lot was in Sodom and Gomorrah, and the things he saw taking place there vexed his spirit.

Ask yourself: do these things vex me? When you see a TV show with people having sex on the screen, does it vex you? It is supposed to. But when you watch porn it arouses you and you get pleasure from it, so you are not vexed with the wicked conversation yet. We have to mold our minds so that when we see these things they vex us, and that comes with time. There is nothing wrong with liking a big booty, God made us to like that, but it has to be your woman’s; looking at another woman and lusting after her for sex is wrong.

“For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul.” He was hearing a bunch of wickedness and seeing a bunch of wickedness, and his soul was vexed. We have to be the same way. Many brothers still watch porn because their soul is not vexed yet. We are not fully there, but we have to bring ourselves there.

precepts.why:
“Ye that love the Lord, hate evil.” If you love God, you have to hate evil, the same way Job saw evil and hated it. You have to train yourself to that. Training yourself to hate evil is going to help you with porn and with the lust of the eyes.

We tell sisters on the street that a woman should not wear what pertains to a man, but then a woman goes by in spandex with cleavage and you are watching and enticed and you like it. We are not supposed to be like that; we have to train ourselves to hate evil.

“Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.” If you love this wicked society, the love of the Father is not in you.

“For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes”: the lust this flesh desires, and the lust of what you see. The same way Job hated all that evil, we have to hate it too, and train our soul to hate this world.

sense.text: “And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.” This is how you know you are of the truth.

“For if our heart condemn us”: your mind condemns you. You know what you are doing, you know what you are battling, and you are not trying to overcome it. “God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.”

When you know you are dealing with something wrong, your conscience already condemns you and your confidence is low: you talk low, you feel you are not worthy, you are messing up. That is what Satan is trying to do to us, to make us weak.

“But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.” Many of us hear the scriptures but are not doing them. Every man has to bring himself to the level where he says: I have to control my sexual appetite, I have to have sexual discipline. Only you can do that. No matter how many scriptures come forth, until you sit down and say I have to fight this, you will keep going through it over and over. There comes that time in your life when you say, nah, I am not messing with this no more; I have to control this. It is the same for every one of us: we all have to come to that acknowledgement.

“He is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass.” The glass is the Bible. After you jerk off, bust that nut and wipe it off your hand with the toilet paper, you think: what I am doing is wrong. Your conscience is battering you, because you know the word and you behold who you are supposed to be. Then you hear the word and still go watch porn and jerk off, and afterwards feel the guilt and tiredness, and all you hear in your mind is that God is going to judge you, if you have a conscience.

“For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.” You see what you are supposed to do and who you are supposed to be, and you go your own way and forget who you are.

“But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.” Not a forgetful hearer, but doing the work.

“Flee also youthful lusts.” Many of you young brothers are dealing with this. The youthful lust some of you young men are dealing with is watching porn and jerking off. Stop it. Flee it, “but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.”

precepts.why:
“I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.” The young men he wrote to overcame the wicked one. What were they overcoming? That youthful lust.

Who comes and tempts you with that lust? Satan. The lusts and desires are already inside you, and when you come to your youth Satan comes and tests you with them. The young men overcame Satan.

sense.text:
Here are the solutions. “Return unto the Lord, and forsake thy sins, make thy prayer before his face, and offend less.” The first thing in overcoming porn and learning sexual discipline is to return unto the Lord, and to offend less.

Offend less: can you go a week without watching porn? Try a week. Pass a week, try two weeks, then three, four, five weeks, then six months, then a year. If you fall and give in, get back up and keep going. What some brothers do is go two months, fall once, and then just keep falling instead of fixing it right there.

When you offend less, the demon becomes less strong. The more you feed it, watching every day, the stronger it gets, like an addiction, and it is even harder to stop. But start starving the demon, a week, two weeks, three, and keep going. You may have cold sweats; it is a heavy addiction. God does not expect you to come to the truth and become perfect at once, but try to offend less.

If you cannot master your own sexual urges, you will destroy everything you build, your name and everything else. You think, I am just watching porn, I am not going to commit adultery on my wife. Yes, you will, eventually. Samson fell from that, David fell, Solomon fell; a lot of our great forefathers fell, but they got up again. That is the power of that lust.

If you cannot stop jerking off for one month, there is something wrong with you; you have a demon on you, a heavy demon of perversion, and you are going to turn into a pervert. Sit down and ask yourself: can I go a week, two weeks, a month without watching porn and jerking off? You will find your life is much better without it; that thing will hold you back.

This is for those who went to God and fasted two days, three days, asking him to take away the porn spirit, and it is still there. “For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool.” This is why we do not glory in ourselves in this truth: we understand the fight and what the brothers are going through. “Lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.”

“And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me.” Read with another scripture, that thorn in the flesh is evil concupiscence: a strong sexual desire. Paul was dealing with evil, wicked sexual thoughts in his mind, and it was given to buffet him and keep him humble, so he would not exalt himself.

“For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.” Three times he went to God and asked that the thorn, that lust, leave him. The same way some men ask God, Lord, I want to stop watching this stuff, and a week later they are back on it again.

“My grace is sufficient for thee”: my mercy is sufficient for you. When you mess up and let it weigh you down and destroy you, Christ’s mercies are enough for you. We want God to take away our shortcomings and the lust inside, but if he took away all the weakness inside of you he would be making you perfect, and he is not going to do that.

“For my strength is made perfect in weakness.” When you finally overcome porn, you become stronger. If the Lord just took that spirit from you, how would you learn to fight off lust, and how could you teach somebody else to overcome theirs, never having fought it? Christ’s mercy is good enough: if you fall, get back up, fix it and stop doing it. He is not making it easy by taking it from you. Keep fighting that demon, overcome it, slay it; that is how you become stronger, and then you are able to teach brothers how to overcome that demon.

This is the secret sauce, the number one thing that helps you overcome that spirit. “For at the first she will walk with him by crooked ways.” At the first, when you just come into this truth. The she is wisdom, the Holy Spirit. Crooked ways like lust and watching porn: wisdom still walks with you even though you are not fully right. That is the Holy Spirit you all have, the thing that keeps telling you, what are you doing, the Lord is going to judge you.

“And bring fear and dread upon him.” That is the secret sauce: fear. Bad things happen to you, and you know why: you were watching porn, and the Lord jacked you up. The reason many will not stop is that they have no fear; it is pleasurable.
